name: @w6w-apps/quickchart
description: Render charts, QR codes, barcodes, word clouds, tables, Graphviz diagrams and watermarked images as images with QuickChart, and save a chart to a short URL.

w6w.longDescription:
QuickChart turns a description into an image. This app exposes its rendering APIs to a workflow.

A workflow can render a Chart.js chart (Chart.js v2, v3 or v4) to PNG, JPEG, WebP, SVG or PDF, save a chart to a short URL that can be dropped into an email or chat message, validate a chart before rendering it, and draft a Chart.js config from a plain-English description. It can also render QR codes (styled, with a centre logo or caption) and read one back from an image, render barcodes in over a hundred symbologies, word clouds, tables, Graphviz diagrams, and watermark one image onto another.

No account is needed: the API answers anonymously within a shared rate limit. A paid API key can be added to the connection for higher limits and longer-lived short URLs; without a connection every action still runs. Images are written to the run's file store and returned as a file reference; SVG output also comes back as text.
